visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with green-streaked hair and a dark grey tank top speaks energetically to the camera, holding a bundle of various colored bras (black, brown, white). (2) The scene transitions to a mobile app screen recording of Uniqlo's bra section, followed by the creator holding a black seamless bra, pulling at its fabric and showing the interior cups to the camera. (3) She holds up a beige Calvin Klein bra, demonstrating the elasticity of the straps and the flexibility of the underwire while pointing at specific seams. (4) The creator appears with digital blue tear overlays on her face, looking upward and sighing while holding a beige bra, expressing frustration about local size availability. (5) She showcases multiple lululemon bras in various colors (brown, green, black) and demonstrates the stretch of a white tank top with a built-in bra. (6) A mobile screen recording of the HANRO brand's expensive price tags is shown; the creator then covers her face with her hands in a 'crying/broke' pose against a grayscale filter. (7) The setting shifts to a gym where the creator, wearing a white cap and black workout gear, performs a plank on a mat and resistance band rows while looking at the camera to explain the importance of core strength.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator; 1 female passer-by seen distantly in the gym background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with dark hair featuring vibrant green streaks, wearing a dark grey ribbed tank top with buttons at the neck and later appearing in black athletic wear with a white baseball cap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic bedroom with a vintage-style clock and books; a digital screen interface showing e-commerce apps; a well-equipped commercial gym with power racks and cable machines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female speech introduces the main topic over a bright, rhythmic electronic BGM. Significant 'Clothing Rustle' sounds occur as bras are moved. (2) Vocal tone becomes more analytical while describing Uniqlo; a 'Ding' sound accompanies the appearance of brand logos. (3) Speech intensity peaks as the creator describes CK comfort, accompanied by sharp 'Whoosh' transition sounds. (4) A mock-sad, low-pitched vocal tone appears with a 'Sad Meme' sound effect during the grayscale portion. (5) Fast-paced narrative returns with high articulation clarity. Frequent 'Digital UI' clicks punctuate the app screen captures. (6) Sudden volume drop in speech for comedic effect when discussing the price of HANRO, followed by a 'Record Scratch' or 'Surprise' sound effect. (7) Calm, measured instructional voiceover in the final gym scene, with faint echoes suggesting a larger indoor space, ending with a final high-pitched upbeat sign-off.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Recommendation 1 -> Recommendation 2 -> Recommendation 3 -> Elite Option -> Long-term Lifestyle Solution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive recommendation guide for women with large breasts who struggle to find supportive and comfortable bras. It transitions from affordable options (Uniqlo) to mid-range (CK, lululemon) and luxury (HANRO), eventually concluding with fitness advice to reduce physical strain, aiming to provide both immediate consumer advice and long-term health tips.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of brand logos, app interfaces, and specific product model names while emphasizing their unique benefits.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social-media fast-cut editing and variety-show style text overlays to maintain engagement while delivering practical product comparisons.
